info.title: Lead Green Green Tokens API
info.summary: GPU energy per million output tokens, grid carbon, GPU hardware.
info.description: Static JSON files. GET only. No authentication. CORS open. Additive changes only within v1. Every schema here is inferred at build time from the published documents themselves, with the field descriptions the API page shows.

Measurement.title: Lead Green contributed measurement, protocol v0.2
Measurement.description: One measured serving configuration, submitted under the measurement protocol at leadgreen.ai/contribute/#protocol. Field names match the configurations in api/v1/models/<slug>.json where they exist. GPU energy only; host, facility and water figures are separate optional fields and are never folded into wh_per_million_output_tokens.

example.description: true only for the example file; example rows are never published

model.description: display name, as on the index where the model is on it

gpu.description: GPU model, e.g. H100 80GB HBM3 SXM

precision.description: weight precision; required, because it decides whether a sliced row is like-for-like

avg_running_batch.description: mean of vllm:num_requests_running over the window, scraped every second; queued requests are not counted

ttft_median_ms.description: median time to first token, if recorded

gpu_power_watts_total.description: average board power summed across every card, or every card holding a loaded slice

runs.description: every run's joules per output token; the row carries their mean

mig_profile.description: e.g. 3g.40gb, or null for a whole card

slices_loaded.description: must equal slice_count: every slice serves the workload at once

prompt_set.description: URL or file name of the published prompt set

vendor_affiliation.description: set when a hardware, cloud or model vendor made or paid for the measurement

site_wue_l_per_kwh.description: optional site water, ISO/IEC 30134-9; never folded into Wh/M

logs.description: power log and engine metrics log, request bodies stripped
